steps.title: Press only after the scan
steps.body: Before you let go of a piece, do one last scan: where can their pieces land after my move? Can they capture anything of mine, or give check?

steps.q: When is the best time to do a blunder check?
options: After choosing the move, before playing it
steps.why: The scan catches mistakes while you can still fix them.

steps.q: What do you look for in the scan?
options: Pieces they can capture, and checks
steps.why: Their replies decide whether your move works.
